elevate.move: Make the three clocks one clock: when a visitor picks jobs in the planner, the hero stopwatch and dial hand jump to the new out-the-door time and the lap sheet prints with the same station drawings, so the tool's output is the signature itself.

Pull the oil table and canyon into the clock: present oil types as the 20:00 lap card in the station-drawing language and turn the canyon band into the 'after 31:00' lap (the drive home) on the same road line as the hero, so every band passes the cover-the-logo test.
